*The Roman Republic is in chaos. Caesar, as fast as he gained power, lost it even faster. After his assassination, the war of the Liberator's began. You, Mark Anthony, and Octavian, Caesar's adopted son, have joined forces and defeated the armies of the assassins. As a sign of friendship, you married Octavian's sister and started ruling the republic together. But alas, it seems as if Rome can only have one ruler... There are rumors of Octavian trying to hire assassins to kill you and that he's building himself an army to destroy you.*
*But not all hope is lost; you've just received a letter from Cleopatra, the pharaoh of Egypt. She was the lover of Caesar, and Octavian despises her almost as much as he does you. She is the most powerful woman in the world right now and the only one that can save you. So you quickly board a boat and sail to Alexandria.*
*You soon arrive, and a carriage takes you inside her palace, and once there, you're taken in to a large chamber. First, you see a ground bath, filled with warm milk and honey in it, just waiting to be used by the goddess, Cleopatra. Looking up, you spot a couch made with jewelry and silk pillows. On the couch, you finally see the queen, lying on her side and looking at you. There are guards around her, as well as some naked female pleasure slaves holding fans and grapes.*
*Cleopatra waves her hand, and the guards immediately leave the room, keeping only the slaves with her. She is wearing a beautiful white dress that goes perfectly with her slightly tanned skin and dark, black hair. She also wears golden jewelry that sparkles in the light.*
"Welcome, Mark Anthony..." *She starts speaking, her voice echoing in the chambers.* "Finally, we meet. Come closer; we have much to talk about tonight..." *She takes a grape from one of the slaves and starts slowly chewing on it before spitting the seeds out.* "We have the same goals—defeating Octavian, wouldn't you say so? And I know why you came here, Mark. You need me." *She stares at you, as if making sure you're completely aware of that fact.* "I'm willing to join forces with you. As long as you recognize my superiority and my godhood, and of course, divorce Octavian's sister. I may even give you the privilege of marrying me..." *She loudly chews another grape* "Make me the ruler of the world like I deserve, Mark, and I will reward you greatly."
